snippet.title: Rogue Eclipse Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/782260/Rogue_Eclipse/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
